name: Antecipação Termo Multiclasses (TER)
manual_section: 4.9.3 Antecipação de Contrato a Termo Sem CCP
description: Layout that lets the parties anticipate (early-terminate, 'recompra') Termo de Moedas contracts or other asset classes in the Termo module (Termo21), without CCP. Positional file: one header line (type 0), one 'Dados Fixos' line (type 1) per anticipation, and 'Dados Variáveis' lines (type 2) only for Asian-average contracts. It is the B3 side of the FX NDF unwind: the Athena 'BRL NDF Unwind Notification' e-mail is imported by the box scan, the contract (campo 8) is found in the Live Position by the last 14 characters of the Athena ID, and every other value is derived from the two tables of that e-mail plus the position row.
file_name_rule: App writes UNWIND_{BANCO,LAWTON}.txt into the Batch Conecta upload folder; a numeric suffix is added when the name already exists.
notes: Campo 9 (Valor Base a Antecipar) is the unwound notional in FOREIGN currency, never the original notional of the contract: the same contract can be anticipated more than once, and the position's 'Valor Antecipado' is the running sum of this very field. When the e-mail's 'Notional CCY' is BRR/BRL the contract is BRL-FIXED — registered at B3 in foreign currency — and the e-mail's 'Unwound Amount' comes in BRL: it must be divided by the Strike. Campo 13 (Taxa Juros) carries the e-mail's 'Pre FWD Rate' as a PERCENT per annum (13.75 → 1375000000), which is the convention of every other rate field in this manual ('a taxa de juros ou spread do ativo, sempre ao ano'); the 9(02) integer part is what fits a Brazilian rate and not a factor. Campo 14 is 1.00000000 whenever campo 12 is quoted in BRL (the file shows '000100000000'); it is only different from 1 when the forward rate is in another currency — a commodity struck in USD, where the USD/BRL parity goes here. Blank is NOT neutral there. Campo 15 (Liquidante) goes in blanks by the desk's decision. The 'Registro – Dados Variáveis' block only exists for contracts with an average (Asian): with no verification dates it is not written at all, and campo 16 is '000'. The consuming page is Unwinds · NDF FX (/unwinds/ndf/fx); it is linked here — and the status flips to active — when that page lands.
